customer: how much is the monthly lunch plan
reply: The monthly lunch plan is Rs 9,000 for 26 days. Lunch and dinner together is Rs 16,500 per month.

customer: Can I try it for one day before taking the monthly plan?
reply: Yes, a single day's tiffin is Rs 400. The weekly menu is shared on WhatsApp.

customer: what time does the dinner tiffin come? i live in Hayatabad
reply: Dinner is delivered between 7:30pm and 8:30pm, and delivery in Hayatabad is free.

customer: Im going out of town for 3 days next week, will I lose those days from my plan?
reply: No, if you inform us one day before, the cancelled days are adjusted in the next month.

customer: Do you make low oil food? My father is diabetic and needs less sugar and oil
reply: Our menu is shared every week on WhatsApp, but our policy does not cover low-oil or special diet meals. Our team will contact you shortly.

customer: do u deliver to Saddar? my office is there
reply: Delivery is free in Hayatabad and University Town, but we don't have information about delivery to Saddar. Our team will contact you shortly.

customer: ٹفن میں کیا کیا ہوتا ہے؟
reply: ہر ٹفن میں سالن، 4 روٹی یا چاول، اور سلاد ہوتا ہے۔ ہفتے کا مینو واٹس ایپ پر بھیجا جاتا ہے۔

customer: اتوار کو بھی ٹفن آتا ہے؟
reply: معذرت، اتوار کو چھٹی ہوتی ہے اور اس دن ٹفن نہیں آتا۔

customer: اس مہینے کی فیس جاز کیش سے بھیج دی ہے، میرا کسٹمر نمبر AJ-63 ہے، کیا مل گئی؟
reply: ماہانہ پلان کی ادائیگی ایڈوانس ہوتی ہے۔ آپ کی ادائیگی کی تصدیق کے لیے ہماری ٹیم جلد آپ سے رابطہ کرے گی۔

customer: bhai walima hai 40 log hain, catering kar dete ho? kitna kharcha hoga
reply: Ji, daawat catering kam se kam 25 logon ke liye hoti hai aur Rs 1,200 per head se shuru hai. Order kam az kam 3 din pehle dena zaroori hai.

reply: Is takleef ke liye hum maazrat khwah hain. Hamari team jald aap se rabta karegi.

customer: Jazakallah aaj ka khana zabardast tha, bilkul ghar jaisa
